audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags exactly this: the level chart gave Brand 6 of 7 stages while Brand only wins 47.62% of real games (Milio is the slightly-favoured side), and full-layer phases[N].side was a flat 'Skill' placeholder on every row while content win[] said Brand/Milio — the two layers already disagreed before this edit.
audit.why: Milio's E (2 charges, ~0.5s base CD) and W shield absorb Brand's poke once he can keep pace, and his R (160/145/130s) cleanses the stun-into-burn chain — so the matchup should read Brand-favoured early (levels 1-3, before shields ramp) and Milio-favoured from first item onward, which nets out near the 47.62% winrate instead of 6-1 Brand.
audit.corrected: Rebalanced the full phases[].side/rating and content win[]/whys[] together: Brand wins levels 1-3, levels 4-5 and level 6 move to even (Skill), first item and 2+ items move to Milio.

audit.why: Brand's level-2 W-Q kill window before Milio's shields ramp, and the first-item DoT-vs-shield race, are the real power spikes here.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text pasted under unrelated titles, and neither the Do's/Don'ts nor breakdown.cooldowns ever mentioned that Milio's E has 2 charges on a near-instant cooldown, which is the interaction that makes all-ins whiff.
audit.why: Milio's E (Warm Hugs) has 2 charges and a ~0.5s base cooldown per the kit, so he can reshield an ally almost immediately after the first charge is used — an all-in timed off 'his shield is down' is wrong.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, and breakdown.cooldowns to state the 2-charge E and Breath of Life's real cooldown numbers.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E-Q stun package answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Milio Breath of Life (160/145/130s CD): the team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. Read it before every duo step-up. - His E (2 charges, near-instant CD) reshields fast — bait it before you commit. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
